behavior_notes: Tap-hold term: 150 ms; another key press resolves the ~/ and ␠- holds immediately.
Shift or Alt plus a tapped Space sends Backspace instead.
Mouse directions: double-tap within 100 ms, then hold for maximum acceleration.
Mouse + Symbols thumbs: Enter on Base, tap-only within 30 ms, and disabled while Shift or Alt is held.
Both Shift keys activate Caps Word; Auto Shift can be toggled from Base.
Key Lock locks the next basic key; pressing Key Lock again releases it.
All system keys require a two-second hold.
System-key RGB feedback: other LEDs turn off; Numpad blinks red while arming and turns yellow when confirmed.
Make builds normally; Shift+Make flashes; Ctrl+Shift+Make enters the bootloader.
EEPROM Clear erases persisted QMK settings and restarts the keyboard.
Python and Bash shebang keys type the complete line followed by Enter.
Build dates reports the firmware compilation datetime for each keyboard half.
RGB status: Caps/Num/Scroll locks and Mouse are blue; Numpad is orange; Symbols is green.
Host layout: EurKEY; printable symbols and macros assume its US-compatible positions.
